content.comment_body: I have a screen on my [product_name] and display some timer values. I want to change a timer value directly from the screen, rather than going into the program's parameter settings. Some say if you press ESC for more than a second, a prompt appears to change the value, but this didn’t work for me. Did I misunderstand something? Thanks for your help.
You can modify timer parameters if you display the parameter within a message on the [product_name] screen.

analysis.insight_summary: The user wants an easier and more intuitive way to adjust timer settings directly from their device screen, aiming to avoid navigating through complicated menus. There is confusion about instructions involving the ESC button, indicating that UI guidance may be unclear or inconsistent. Although a solution exists, the steps to access it might not be clearly documented or visible in the interface.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to quickly and easily change timer values straight from the device screen with as little navigation as possible.
